rules.v: Only administrative regulations under a non-labor statute apply
rules.vi: Hanya peraturan administratif di bawah UU non-ketenagakerjaan
rules.n: Labor terms sit in regulations under the Act for Distant Water Fisheries (Art. 26), outside the Labor Standards Act. A pending civil case (the Yu Fu case, hearings 2025) argues the Labor Standards Act should apply.
rules.s: Act for Distant Water Fisheries 2016; NYCU Transit Asia court observation 2025

rules.v: A separate floor applies that is lower than, or not linked to, the national minimum
rules.vi: Berlaku batas upah terpisah yang lebih rendah atau tidak terkait upah minimum nasional
rules.n: The Regulations set a minimum of US$550 a month, adjustable by annual announcement (Art. 6-1(2), added 18 Nov 2025). US$570 for crew newly recruited from 2026 is reported by the Ministry of Agriculture, but the Fisheries Agency notice could not be found or reached (rechecked 13 Nov 2026), so that figure is unverified. Both are well below Taiwan's national minimum wage under the Minimum Wage Act (in force 1 Jan…
rules.s: Overseas Employment Regulations Art. 6-1(2) (amended 18 Nov 2025); Minimum Wage Act; Ministry of Agriculture annual report 2025; Focus Taiwan, 6 Jan 2026

rules.v: Only minimum rest periods apply, or limits apply with sector exclusions
rules.vi: Hanya waktu istirahat minimum, atau batas berlaku dengan pengecualian sektor
rules.n: At least 10 hours of rest in any 24 (6 of them consecutive) and 77 hours in any 7 days, benchmarked to ILO C188; temporary exceptions with compensatory rest; no limit on hours as such.
rules.s: Overseas Employment Regulations Art. 6(1)(7); ICSF Samudra 88 (2022)

rules.v: Cannot change without the employer's consent
rules.vi: Tidak dapat pindah tanpa persetujuan majikan
rules.n: Contracts are with the vessel operator through an overseas agency. A transfer procedure exists, but only with the former operator's signed release, so crew cannot change employer without consent. Agencies may not force a transfer.

rules.v: May join but faces legal limits, or residence status makes membership largely theoretical
rules.vi: Boleh bergabung tetapi dibatasi hukum, atau status tinggal membuat keanggotaan nyaris teoretis
rules.n: No statutory bar, but crew who never enter Taiwan's labor market cannot in practice join a Taiwanese union. Indonesian unions seek a bilateral agreement.

rules.v: Fees charged to the worker are prohibited in the destination's law
rules.vi: Biaya yang dibebankan kepada pekerja dilarang oleh hukum negara tujuan
rules.n: The Regulations bar agencies from charging crew service or recruitment fees and from withholding wages as a penalty, bar operators from making crew bear recruitment costs or keeping passports (safekeeping with consent allowed), and require full, direct wage payment. Recoded from 1 to 2 after checking the text; NGOs still report deposits and deductions in practice, which this de jure code does not capture.
rules.s: Overseas Employment Regulations Arts 13(2)(3), 13(2)(5), 30(4), 30(19), 30(20); Greenpeace, Choppy Waters (2020)

rules.v: Only employer-bought private or accident insurance is required
rules.vi: Hanya asuransi swasta atau kecelakaan yang dibeli majikan
rules.n: Employer-bought accident, life and medical insurance (medical cover at least NT$300,000, death cover at least NT$1.5 million, payable to the crew member); not national labor insurance.

rules.v: Only general channels, or channels hard to reach from the workplace (for example at sea)
rules.vi: Hanya saluran umum, atau saluran yang sulit dijangkau dari tempat kerja (misalnya di laut)
rules.n: The 1955 hotline accepts calls, and vessels must allow crew to communicate, but access at sea is limited. Since the 18 November 2025 amendment, operators must join a wage-advance mechanism or give a bank guarantee before hiring, and report wage payments within 10 days.
rules.s: Overseas Employment Regulations Arts 2-1, 6-1 (amended 18 Nov 2025); Ministry of Agriculture, 18 Nov 2025

rules.fi: Jalur ke izin tinggal jangka panjang
rules.v: No route: fixed maximum stay, or time does not count
rules.vi: Tidak ada jalur: masa tinggal maksimum tetap, atau masa tinggal tidak dihitung
rules.n: Crew are never admitted to Taiwan as workers; no residence accrues.

rules.v: Barred
rules.vi: Dilarang
rules.n: Not applicable: no residence in Taiwan.

rules.v: The general labor statute applies in full
rules.vi: UU ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku penuh
rules.n: The Labor Standards Act applies to fishing employers.
rules.s: Labor Standards Act; Ministry of Labor

rules.v: The national statutory minimum wage applies
rules.vi: Upah minimum nasional berlaku
rules.n: The national minimum wage under the Minimum Wage Act (in force 1 Jan 2024) applies, replacing the basic wage; the reported rule allowing deductions for board and lodging was not confirmed from an official text.
rules.s: Minimum Wage Act Art. 3; Ministry of Labor

rules.v: Statutory limits on hours apply
rules.vi: Batas jam kerja menurut undang-undang berlaku
rules.n: Labor Standards Act hours apply in law; enforcement on board is reported to be weak.

rules.v: May change only on listed grounds, a limited number of times or with official approval
rules.vi: Hanya boleh pindah atas alasan tertentu, terbatas jumlahnya atau dengan persetujuan resmi
rules.n: Transfer only on grounds listed in Employment Service Act Art. 59 (for example closure, abuse, employer's death) or by three-party agreement. The rule requiring workers to leave Taiwan for a day before starting a new contract (Art. 52(4)) was deleted in November 2016. Total stay remains capped at 12 years (14 for qualifying home carers).

rules.v: May form and join unions on equal terms
rules.vi: Boleh membentuk dan bergabung dengan serikat secara setara
rules.n: May join and form unions; the Yilan Migrant Fishermen Union was registered in 2013.

rules.v: Fees charged to the worker are capped or regulated
rules.vi: Biaya bagi pekerja dibatasi atau diatur
rules.n: Broker service fees are capped by the Ministry of Labor (monthly, falling with years of service); fees in sending countries vary.

rules.v: Enrolled in the national labor or health insurance schemes
rules.vi: Terdaftar dalam skema jaminan ketenagakerjaan atau kesehatan nasional
rules.n: Labor insurance since the early 1990s and National Health Insurance; work-permit holders are enrolled in NHI at once, without the six-month wait that applies to other foreign residents.
rules.s: Labor Insurance Act; National Health Insurance Act; Oishi and Chien (2026)

rules.v: A dedicated public channel for migrant workers in their languages
rules.vi: Saluran publik khusus pekerja migran dalam bahasa mereka
rules.n: 1955 hotline in five languages; local labor bureaus.

rules.fi: Jalur ke izin tinggal jangka panjang
rules.v: May move to another status that can lead to permanent residence, on conditions
rules.vi: Dapat pindah ke status lain yang dapat mengarah ke izin tinggal tetap, dengan syarat
rules.n: Since 30 April 2022 migrant workers with six years' continuous service may be retained as intermediate skilled workers. Time as an ordinary migrant worker does not count toward permanent residence (Immigration Act Art. 25), so the route runs through years in the intermediate status; this reading is ours and is not stated by the Ministry. The route now rests on a new regulation in force from 30 Dec 2025, with a wage…
rules.s: Ministry of Labor, Long-term Retention of Migrant Workers Program (releases 17 Feb and 29 Apr 2022) and regulation of 30 Dec 2025 (official guidance); Immigration Act Arts 23, 25

rules.v: Barred
rules.vi: Dilarang
rules.n: Families of migrant workers under Employment Service Act Art. 46(1)(8)–(10) cannot obtain residence.

rules.v: Excluded from labor law; terms set by contract or sponsorship only
rules.vi: Dikecualikan dari hukum ketenagakerjaan; syarat hanya diatur kontrak atau sponsor
rules.n: Labor Standards Act does not apply to household workers; the Employment Service Act governs foreign household workers. A Domestic Workers Protection bill is pending.

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required, no language rule
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib, tanpa aturan bahasa
rules.n: Contract required for the permit; standard contract by the ministry.

rules.v: A separate or lower minimum, or one set only by policy
rules.vi: Upah minimum terpisah atau lebih rendah, atau hanya ditetapkan lewat kebijakan
rules.n: Excluded from the statutory minimum; a minimum set by policy for household caregivers.

rules.v: Periodic payment required, without further safeguards
rules.vi: Pembayaran berkala wajib, tanpa pengaman lain
rules.n: Monthly payment.

rules.v: No limit and no daily rest rule
rules.vi: Tidak ada batas dan aturan istirahat harian
rules.n: No limit.

rules.v: Weekly rest provided but it may be worked for pay or another day, or is shorter
rules.vi: Istirahat mingguan ada tetapi boleh diganti uang atau hari lain, atau lebih pendek
rules.n: Weekly rest day by contract, which may be worked for pay.

rules.v: Shorter than for other workers
rules.vi: Lebih pendek dari pekerja lain
rules.n: Annual leave by contract.

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
rules.vi: Hak tegas, atau penahanan oleh pemberi kerja dilarang dengan sanksi
rules.n: Employers and agencies may not keep the worker's passport or residence permit.

rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
rules.vi: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan
rules.n: Accommodation in the employer's home.

rules.v: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
rules.vi: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
rules.n: Change allowed with agreement or in listed cases.

rules.v: Fees capped
rules.vi: Biaya dibatasi
rules.n: Service fees capped by the ministry.

rules.v: Licensing only
rules.vi: Hanya perizinan
rules.n: Licensed agencies with ratings.

rules.v: Complaint-based or agency inspection only
rules.vi: Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen
rules.n: Complaint-based.

rules.v: Administrative settlement only, or narrower access
rules.vi: Hanya penyelesaian administratif, atau akses lebih sempit
rules.n: Labor bureau mediation.

rules.v: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
rules.vi: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja
rules.n: National Health Insurance compulsory.

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.v: General criminal or civil law only
rules.vi: Hanya hukum pidana atau perdata umum
rules.n: General law; sexual harassment law.
Not determined.

decisions.nm: J.Y. Interpretation No. 708 (detention of foreigners pending deportation)
decisions.pe: Taiwan held foreigners, including migrant workers who had left their employers, in detention before deportation without a judge checking. The Constitutional Court said a court must be able to review such detention quickly.
decisions.pi: Taiwan menahan orang asing, termasuk pekerja migran yang meninggalkan majikan, sebelum dideportasi tanpa pemeriksaan hakim. MK menyatakan pengadilan harus bisa segera meninjau penahanan itu.

decisions.nm: J.Y. Interpretation No. 710 (deportation and detention of mainland Chinese residents)
decisions.pe: Following its decision on foreigners, the Constitutional Court said people from mainland China must also get a hearing before removal and a quick court check on any detention.
decisions.pi: Mengikuti putusan tentang orang asing, MK menyatakan warga Tiongkok daratan juga harus didengar sebelum dikeluarkan dan penahanannya segera diperiksa pengadilan.

decisions.nm: J.Y. Interpretation No. 560 (funeral allowance for foreign workers’ family members)
decisions.pe: A foreign worker in Taiwan asked for the funeral allowance that Taiwanese workers get when a family member dies. The rules excluded family who lived abroad. The Constitutional Court let the rule stand.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja asing di Taiwan meminta tunjangan pemakaman yang didapat pekerja Taiwan saat anggota keluarga meninggal. Aturan mengecualikan keluarga yang tinggal di luar negeri. MK mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.nm: J.Y. Interpretation No. 497 (entry and residence of people from mainland China)
decisions.pe: Taiwan limited how people from mainland China could come and stay. The Constitutional Court said these limits were allowed.
decisions.pi: Taiwan membatasi cara warga Tiongkok daratan datang dan tinggal. MK menyatakan pembatasan itu boleh.

decisions.nm: J.Y. Interpretation No. 618 (former mainland spouses and public office)
decisions.pe: A woman from mainland China married a Taiwanese man, became a resident and was hired as a civil servant, then dismissed under the ten-year rule. The Constitutional Court let the rule stand.
decisions.pi: Seorang perempuan dari Tiongkok daratan menikah dengan pria Taiwan, menjadi penduduk, dan diangkat sebagai pegawai negeri, lalu diberhentikan berdasarkan aturan sepuluh tahun. MK mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.pi: Masuk dan tinggalnya warga negara tanpa registrasi rumah tangga.

decisions.pe: Permission to enter Taiwan for nationals without household registration.
decisions.pi: Izin masuk Taiwan bagi warga negara tanpa registrasi rumah tangga.

decisions.pe: Adoption of relatives from mainland China and family unity.
decisions.pi: Adopsi kerabat dari Tiongkok daratan dan kesatuan keluarga.

decisions.pe: Dual nationals barred from posts as doctors in public hospitals.
decisions.pi: Warga berkewarganegaraan ganda dilarang menjabat dokter di rumah sakit umum.

decisions.pe: Ban on charging fees for brokering cross-border marriages.
decisions.pi: Larangan memungut biaya perantara perkawinan lintas negara.

help.de: Free 24-hour line for complaints and advice, in Chinese, English, Thai, Indonesian and Vietnamese. Can refer you to one of 22 Foreign Worker Consultation Service Centers.
help.di: Saluran gratis 24 jam untuk pengaduan dan konsultasi, dalam bahasa Mandarin, Inggris, Thai, Indonesia dan Vietnam. Bisa merujuk ke salah satu dari 22 pusat layanan konsultasi pekerja asing.
